title: Silence and filler cut with an EDL to approve
what_it_does: Finds pauses (ffmpeg silencedetect) and filler words (Turkish ıı/eee, optionally şey; English um/uh), writes an edit decision list the person can approve, then cuts frame-accurately into cut.mp4 and writes the word JSON retimed to the cut. Keeps 0.12 s of audio around speech.
when_to_use: After transcribe-local on a talking recording, before captions and cards. The cut file, not the raw file, is what the composition uses, so captions stay in sync. Not for music or footage without speech.
notes: Own code. The EDL-then-apply idea follows herk-edit-kit's cut-silences and the filler/pause options follow kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill's silence.py (both MIT); no code from either is copied. End-to-end proof: catalog/lanes/talking-head/example/run-proof.sh.
